disposition_reason: The legacy empirical contrast is descriptive, but the source also trains an RNN to match prescribed time-varying readout targets and releases that original model. Whole-paper eligibility therefore remains unresolved until its original fit/evaluation criterion, complete conditions and author result are recovered. No new heldout response predictor or invented loss is substituted.

source_paper.title: Recurrent cortical networks encode natural sensory statistics via sequence filtering

evidence.locator: Results and Discussion: patterned stimulation, correct temporal context and recurrent sequence filtering
evidence.supports: The final article’s claim concerns context-dependent biological responses and a supporting artificial-network demonstration.
The author release provides quantitative figure data and illustrative notebooks, not a frozen heldout predictive benchmark.

evidence.locator: Repository Structure: code/Figure2_panelBC_npz.ipynb, code/Figure3_panelGI_npz.ipynb, code/RNN_seqmodel.ipynb, src/sequence_paper_functions.py
evidence.supports: Empirical panel reconstruction and RNN demonstration are separate source activities; filenames follow the release metadata.

evidence.locator: Final Neuron article Methods, Modeling, page e4; Figure 4 artificial recurrent network
evidence.supports: The RNN recurrent weights are trained to match specified sparse scaled time-varying targets; fixed input/output weights, original trained/control/scrambled conditions and 500 training epochs are source-defined. A numeric performance criterion/score is not established by this description.

target.description: Recover the original Figure 4 RNN readout-to-prescribed-target task and its reported fit/evaluation criterion. It is a source-native candidate performance route; empirical sequence/context contrasts remain biological calibration.

dataset.description: Zenodo 18726362 v1, sequenceFiltering.zip md5:35b86a22f10b600dbd98f23db3f9343d, includes original RNN_seqmodel.ipynb, modules_simpleRNN.py and figure data. No archive payload was acquired in this review.

cohort.description: Original simulation conditions use sequences of five patterns from eighteen patterns, with trained and control/scrambled sequence constructions. Complete instantiated sequence roster and independent network/run population need recovery; these are not biological animals.

split.description: Retain the source trained/control/untrained sequence roles and exact original evaluation exposure. This route may evaluate in-sample fit; a new heldout partition is neither required by this contract nor silently substituted. Original memberships and procedure remain unbound.

inputs.description: Original time-varying input patterns, prescribed targets and fixed input/output weights; exact generated arrays and initialization states must be recovered. Do not replace them with arbitrary surrogate sequences.

preprocessing.description: Final Methods specifies recurrent-weight training and distinct target scaling for trained versus control sequences. Exact notebook preprocessing, numerical integration, sequence instances and output correspondence need source execution binding.

metric.description: Recover the source-author RNN fit/evaluation criterion and its formula/direction. Matching prescribed outputs suggests an ordered fit route, but neither MSE nor a numeric source score is assumed without source evidence. Larger biological response or lower Figure 2C reconstruction error is not that score.

aggregation.description: Recover original reduction across output units, time points, sequences and independent model runs, including all original conditions. No new scalar is made from the biological and simulated figures.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 4 RNN output-target fit/evaluation criterion, not yet recovered

published_baseline.description: Original readout training targets are verified, but an exact source-reported ordered score, criterion and complete evaluation support are unrecovered. No numerical baseline is inferred from successful qualitative boosting.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The source archive identifies the original RNN notebook/module, but no authenticated replay or native score is established. Figure 2C vector scoring is a separate empirical calibration component.

minimum_effect.rationale: Define improvement only after recovering the original author criterion, exact target exposure and run variability. No invented loss, arbitrary amplification margin or stronger significance is admissible.

uncertainty.method: Recover original independent network/sequence generation and evaluation repetitions, then predeclare paired uncertainty for the original criterion; no new holdout design is assumed.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Independent simulated network/sequence realization under the source protocol; time bins and units are dependent outputs.
uncertainty.rationale: Biological animals, simulated units and training epochs cannot be pooled as independent performance replications.

paper_win_requires: Recover and bind an ordered criterion actually evaluated for the source RNN, including exact original targets, condition roster, exposure, metric reduction and author baseline before activation.
Retain original trained/control/untrained sequence definitions and full source conditions; a newly invented prediction task, loss or heldout split does not establish this source-paper win.
Compare with an authenticated source-author replay under identical original information and resource conditions, using a justified effect and uncertainty rule fixed before final assessment.
Empirical Figure 2C reference agreement, larger biological sequence effects and qualitative RNN boosting remain calibration evidence until the source performance comparison is established.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; source-paper reproduction and same-task improvement are separate outcomes.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive while the original RNN task/criterion is unresolved. Later iteration must preserve its source-defined training/evaluation exposure, including an in-sample criterion if that is what the source actually evaluated.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate, original generated sequences/targets, source conditions, training recipe and metric before final source-protocol evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: No improvement reward from the legacy empirical scorer. Only a recovered original RNN criterion with complete source support may support activation.
episode.baseline_policy: Separate published original RNN result, authenticated author replay, empirical figure reconstruction and any new prediction extension. No qualitative demonstration is promoted to a numeric baseline. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Exact original RNN fit/evaluation criterion, direction, published result and complete scored condition set are unrecovered.
Native sequence/target instances, initialization, original exposure and per-run aggregation require recovery.
No source-native evaluator/replay, justified effect, uncertainty design or fixed concrete budgets.
Legacy empirical Figure 2C reconstruction cannot score the original RNN performance route.

legacy.notes: Preserve the Figure 2C scoring adapter, empirical contrast reconstruction and qualification history as calibration. Whole-paper review identifies the original RNN modeling route for source recovery without activating a substitute task.
